_instructions.slack: Replace slack_webhook_url with your Slack Incoming Webhook URL. Get it at https://api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks
_instructions.gdrive_folder: google_drive_folder_id is the pipeline outputs folder (research, strategy, drafts). Already configured.
_instructions.gdrive_final_folder: Replace gdrive_final_folder_id with the ID of your 'Ready to Post' Google Drive folder (the string after /folders/ in the URL). Create this folder in Drive first.
_instructions.gdrive_credentials: Place your OAuth2 credentials JSON (downloaded from Google Cloud Console) at tools/credentials.json — see tools/upload_gdrive.py header for full setup steps
